page_title: PAR 1-0 FIO | Parma v Fiorentina 27/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's the end of the match.
90+7' Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
90+4' Carlos Cuesta has decided to substitute Mateo Pellegrino and he is replaced by Milan Djuric (Parma).
90+4' Here comes a substitution. Benjamin Cremaschi (Parma) is brought on as a substitute for Mandela Keita.
90+3' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) was quite harsh and Marco Guida didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+3' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

90+3' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom left corner is, however, superbly saved by Edoardo Corvi! The ball is out of play. Fiorentina win a corner kick.
90+2' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Moise Kean (Fiorentina) heads on.
90+2' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
90+1' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
90+1' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 10:14.

87' Edoardo Corvi (Parma) attempts to delay the restart of play. The referee doesn't like it. Edoardo Corvi (Parma) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
86' Paolo Vanoli prepares a substitution. Pietro Comuzzo is replaced by Eddy Kouadio (Fiorentina).
85' Oliver Sorensen (Parma) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
82' Albert Gudmundsson does well to cross from a difficult angle and find Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) on the edge of the six-yard box, but his header slips well wide of the right post.
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Christian Ordonez (Parma) comes onto the pitch so that Adrian Bernabe Garcia can be given a rest.
80' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
79' Gaetano Oristanio (Parma) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post.
78' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
77' Simon Sohm (Fiorentina) is penalised for holding. Marco Guida signals a set piece. Parma have a free kick.
76' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) takes the corner but it's cleared.
76' Paolo Vanoli has decided to make a change. Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) replaces Fabiano Parisi.
76' Substitution. Simon Sohm (Fiorentina) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Cher Ndour walks off.
76' Dodo (Fiorentina) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
75' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it well wide of the right post.
74' Emanuele Valeri plays a delightful lofted ball into the middle of the box and it deserved better, but Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) could only send a weak header well wide of the right post.
73' Niccolo Fortini (Fiorentina) fires the ball towards the left side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
72' 10:19 – the total goal attempt statistics. 2:3 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.

70' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man. A rebound falls at the feet of Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) on the edge of the box, but his powerful shot veers well wide of the left post.
69' A fine solo run by Moise Kean (Fiorentina) takes him deep into the box, but it comes to nothing as his shot flies well wide of the right post.
68' Here's the change. Jacob Ondrejka leaves the pitch and Nahuel Estevez (Parma) comes on as a substitute.
67' Carlos Cuesta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gaetano Oristanio (Parma) replacing Adrian Benedyczak.
67' Niccolo Fortini (Fiorentina) picks up a rebound, moves into space and fires a shot at goal from long range that rises sharply and curls well wide of the left post.
67' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

67' Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom left corner, but Edoardo Corvi thwarts him with a great two-handed save. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Fiorentina.
65' Dodo slings over a decent looking cross towards Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina), who outjumps his marker in the middle of the box but sends a poor header high over the bar.
64' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

63' Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) misses a big chance from point-blank range as he struck the ball towards the top right corner. His promising effort following the corner kick was, to his disappointment, thwarted by Edoardo Corvi with a fabulous save.
63' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
63' The manager makes a subsitution with Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) coming on for Rolando Mandragora.
63' Dodo (Fiorentina) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The linesman makes the right call and Fiorentina will have a corner.
62' An attempted cross from Niccolo Fortini (Fiorentina) is cleared.
60' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.

59' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Marco Guida blows his whistle for a foul. Fiorentina win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
59' Good movement by Adrian Benedyczak (Parma), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
57' Moise Kean is picked out by Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina), but one of the defenders arrives to clear.

55' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him. Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) has a great chance inside the box following a rebound off a defender, but somehow he gets underneath the ball and it flies high over the bar.
54' Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
54' The resulting corner, taken by Emanuele Valeri (Parma), comes to nothing.
54' Oliver Sorensen (Parma) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Parma.
52' Dodo plays a lofted pass into the six-yard box. Moise Kean (Fiorentina) gets his head on the ball but balloons it high over the bar.
50' It could have been a good chance to score! Dodo (Fiorentina) fails to release Moise Kean with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears.
48' 1 - 0 Oliver Sorensen (Parma) gets on the scoresheet with a sweet header that goes inside the left post!
47' Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Moise Kean, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception.
46' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Dodo (Fiorentina).
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Paolo Vanoli probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Mattia Viti (Fiorentina). He is replaced by Niccolo Fortini.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+1' The match has reached half-time.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
44' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) will deliver the corner kick.

43' Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) creates space for himself in the box and shoots, but the effort is unwittingly blocked by one of his own teammates. Parma force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

42' Emanuele Valeri curls the ball into the box from the corner, but Alessandro Circati (Parma) makes a right mess of a close-range header when under pressure and sends it well wide of the right post.
42' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

42' Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Parma force their opponents to concede a corner.
41' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
37' Albert Gudmundsson finds Dodo (Fiorentina) unmarked on the edge of the box, but his thunderbolt of shot goes high over the bar.
36' The ball falls for Moise Kean (Fiorentina) in the box, and he hits a first-time shot at goal that is inadvertently blocked by a defender. A bit unlucky there!
35' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) attempts to find Albert Gudmundsson with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
33' Total attempts – 6:6. The shots on goal statistics – 1:1.

32' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) gets on the end of a good cross and shoots, but his attempt is inadvertently blocked by one of his own teammates. Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) is furious with himself as he misses a clear opportunity from the six-yard box. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the left post.
31' Sascha Britschgi (Parma) gets to a rebound from the corner kick and unleashes a long-range shot. Promising try, but it goes way wide of the left post.
31' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
28' Dodo plays a lofted ball into Moise Kean (Fiorentina) near the penalty spot, but the ball flies off the top of his head and goes high over the bar.
27' Sascha Britschgi (Parma) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

26' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Edoardo Corvi. This effort really didn't trouble him.
24' A pass by Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
23' Sascha Britschgi (Parma) and Adrian Benedyczak try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.
22' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
22' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
21' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the free kick from Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) on the edge of the box. Fiorentina have a corner.
20' This is a yellow card! Alessandro Circati (Parma) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
19' Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) hits a shot towards the left side of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by David de Gea.
17' A long-range effort by Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) after he received a good pass was well wide of the right post.
16' 62:38 – the ratio of ball possession.
14' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
13' Oliver Sorensen (Parma) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has David de Gea scrambling, but it flies just wide of the left post.
11' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
10' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Marco Guida signals.
8' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Moise Kean (Fiorentina) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
7' Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the right post.
5' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
4' The corner kick from Emanuele Valeri (Parma) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
4' Sascha Britschgi (Parma) sprays a pass out to Adrian Benedyczak, but he can't beat his man inside the box. Parma will take a corner kick.
3' Mattia Viti (Fiorentina) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
2' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
1' Mateo Pellegrino loses the ball after receiving a sweet pass from Adrian Benedyczak (Parma).
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Parma will have the kick-off.
Marco Guida will officiate today.
